en.headline: Ride-hailing regulatory regime takes effect with combined taxi test launch
en.dek: Most legal provisions governing ride-hailing services come into force today, while the Transport Department begins accepting applications for a new combined taxi and ride-hailing vehicle driving test.
body: Most of the legal provisions under the Road Traffic (Amendment) (Ride-hailing Service) Ordinance relating to the regulation of ride-hailing services took effect on Monday. The remaining provisions will come into force on 22 August 2027.

The subsidiary legislation sets out details of the regulatory framework, introduces a combined driving test for taxis and ride-hailing vehicles, specifies limits on the number of ride-hailing vehicle permits, and confirms the commencement dates. The Government expects to begin issuing ride-hailing service licences in phases as early as the end of November so that licensed platforms can start preparatory work.

The Transport Department also launched the combined driving test for taxis and ride-hailing vehicles on Monday, with applications opening the same day. The first batch of candidates is expected to sit the enhanced combined written test from mid-September. Details of application arrangements for the various licences and permits will be announced later.

zh.headline: 網約車規管制度今日生效 合併駕駛考試同步開放申請
zh.dek: 規管網約車服務的大部分法例條文今日起生效，運輸署同日推出的士及網約車合併駕駛考試並開始接受申請。
body: 《2025年道路交通（修訂）（網約車服務）條例》中有關規管網約車服務的大部分法律條文於星期一正式生效，其餘條文將於2027年8月22日實施。
相關附屬法例訂明規管框架細節、引入的士及網約車合併駕駛考試、訂定網約車車輛許可證數目上限，以及各項條文的生效日期。政府預期最早於11月底起分階段發出網約車服務牌照，讓持牌平台可盡早展開準備工作。
運輸署同日推出的士及網約車合併駕駛考試，並即日開始接受申請。首批考生預計由9月中起應考經加強的合併筆試。各類牌照及許可證的申請安排詳情將稍後公布。
